items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, he was my idol. He showed me how to play like Art Tatum.

ctx.x: I guess there’s nothing else you can say about Tatum. Raymond Walters.
Oh, he was my idol. He showed me how to play like Art Tatum. He stayed drunk most of the time but he sure could play.
